questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.q_zh: 蜘蛛有几条腿？
questions.explain_zh: 蜘蛛有 8 条腿，昆虫有 6 条。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: What do we carve for Halloween?
questions.q_zh: 万圣节我们会雕刻什么？

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which animal has a black mask on its face?
questions.q_zh: 哪种动物脸上像戴着黑色面罩？
questions.explain_en: Raccoons live in Stanley Park and come out at night.
questions.explain_zh: 斯坦利公园里有浣熊，晚上出来活动。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which animal says 'hoo-hoo' at night?
questions.q_zh: 晚上“呼呼”叫的是什么动物？

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: What must you wear on your head when you ride a bike?
questions.q_zh: 骑自行车时头上一定要戴什么？
questions.explain_en: In B.C., wearing a bike helmet is the law.
questions.explain_zh: 在卑诗省，骑车戴头盔是法律规定。

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: When riding past people walking, you should…
questions.q_zh: 骑车经过走路的人时，应该怎么做？
questions.explain_en: Slow down and ring your bell to say hi.
questions.explain_zh: 放慢速度，按一下车铃打招呼。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: What is next to the Stanley Park seawall?
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园的海堤旁边是什么？
questions.explain_en: The seawall runs right along the ocean.

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Bats sleep in the daytime and fly at…
questions.q_zh: 蝙蝠白天睡觉，什么时候飞出来？
questions.explain_en: Bats are nocturnal: awake at night.
questions.explain_zh: 蝙蝠是夜行动物，晚上醒着。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: What colour is a Halloween pumpkin?
questions.q_zh: 万圣节的南瓜是什么颜色？
questions.explain_zh: 大多数万圣节南瓜是橙色的。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which bird honks and flies in a V shape?
questions.q_zh: 哪种鸟会“嘎嘎”叫、排成 V 字飞？
questions.explain_en: Canada geese live around Lost Lagoon.
questions.explain_zh: 加拿大鹅住在 Lost Lagoon 湖边。

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: When you trick-or-treat at night, what helps cars see you?
questions.q_zh: 晚上讨糖时，什么能让汽车看见你？
questions.explain_en: Lights and reflective tape keep you safe.
questions.explain_zh: 灯光和反光条能保护你的安全。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Tall trees in Stanley Park grow from…
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园的大树是从什么长出来的？
questions.explain_en: Every big tree started as a tiny seed or cone.
questions.explain_zh: 每棵大树都是从小小的种子长出来的。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which animal lives in the water by the seawall?
questions.q_zh: 哪种动物住在海堤旁的水里？
questions.explain_en: Harbour seals swim near the seawall.
questions.explain_zh: 港海豹会在海堤附近游泳。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: What do children say at the door on Halloween?
questions.q_zh: 万圣节孩子们在门口说什么？

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! Bara loves water. Would Bara like the seawall?
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！Bara 爱水，它会喜欢海堤吗？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras love water, though they prefer fresh water.
questions.explain_zh: 卡皮巴拉爱水，不过它们更喜欢淡水。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! What costume suits a capybara best?
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！哪套万圣节服装最适合卡皮巴拉？
questions.explain_en: Bara can't skate, but a pumpkin hat looks great!
questions.explain_zh: Bara 不会溜冰，但戴南瓜帽超好看！

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! Capybaras and raccoons both come from…
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！卡皮巴拉和浣熊老家都在哪个大洲？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras are from South America; raccoons from North America.
questions.explain_zh: 卡皮巴拉来自南美洲，浣熊来自北美洲。
